provenance.description: PLANTED: a well-resolved, converged, in-envelope 2D cavity with a central square obstacle. The hypothesis predicts the obstacle BLOCKS recirculation and LOWERS mean speed to ~0.30 m/s; the run instead returns 0.79 m/s, ~2x the open-cavity baseline and OPPOSITE the predicted direction - the gap between obstacle and walls jets the flow. A trustworthy instrument strongly contradicting the prediction: a discovery signal.
provenance.authorship: hand-authored for the Step-20.7 triage battery; NOT a real run
provenance.expected_diagnosis: genuine_surprise - instrument trustworthy here, result strongly contradicts the prediction

chosen_hypothesis.statement: Placing a square obstacle at the cavity center lowers the volume-averaged flow speed by blocking the primary recirculation.
chosen_hypothesis.rationale: A central blockage should obstruct the dominant recirculating vortex and reduce interior kinetic energy.

experiment_spec.title: Central-obstacle effect on mean cavity flow speed
experiment_spec.objective: Compare volume-averaged flow speed of a cavity with a central square obstacle against the ~0.42 m/s open-cavity baseline at Re=200.

qoi.name: mean_flow_speed
qoi.definition: Volume-averaged velocity magnitude at the final time.
qoi.how_extracted: volAverage of mag(U) at the latest written time.

success_criterion.statement: Mean flow speed with the obstacle is below the 0.42 m/s open-cavity baseline.

regime.notes: Re = U*L/nu = 200, 2D laminar, inside the validated envelope. Open-cavity baseline volAverage(mag(U)) approximately 0.42 m/s at this Re. The central obstacle is a 2D square blockage, fully representable by the 2D mesh.

mini_experiment.expected_observation: The obstacle blocks the primary recirculation and the mean flow speed drops well below the 0.42 baseline, to roughly 0.30 m/s.

full_experiment.design: Single obstacle case compared to the open-cavity baseline.

fidelity_verdict.label: trust
fidelity_verdict.rationale: 2D square obstacle at Re=200 is inside the validated 2D-laminar envelope and fully mesh-representable

stage4_summaries.reason: reached endTime=20.0 with all final residuals < 0.001

expectation.note: Well-resolved (64x64), converged, residuals ~1e-8, max_Courant 0.44, Re=200 in-envelope - the instrument is trustworthy here. Yet mean speed 0.79 is ~2x the 0.42 baseline and OPPOSITE the predicted drop: a genuine, physically interesting contradiction (gap-jetting), a discovery signal. Decision: gather more_data to confirm, or back_to_ideation to revise the blockage hypothesis.
